# Phys.org

> > Phys.org is a leading science news aggregator covering physics, quantum mechanics, nanotechnology, biology, and interdisciplinary research from journals like Nature, PNAS, and Science.

Phys.org provides daily breaking science news, research updates, and feature stories across all scientific disciplines. The site aggregates content from peer-reviewed journals and academic institutions, making cutting-edge research accessible to both scientists and the general public.

## Key Topics

- Quantum Physics
- Nanotechnology
- Optical Clocks
- Superconductivity
- Mesoscale Physics
- Quantum Entanglement
- Ecology and Invasive Species
- Academic Publishing
- Peer-Reviewed Research
- Interdisciplinary Research
- Nature Journal
- PNAS (Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences)
- Science Journal
- AMOC (Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation)
- Science X Network

## Core News & Updates

- [Phys.org Homepage](https://phys.org): Homepage: daily science news on research and tech breakthroughs
- [Latest Science News](https://phys.org/latest-news): Latest breaking science news headlines across all disciplines
- [Top Science News of the Week](https://phys.org/weekly-news): Weekly science highlights: MeerKAT discoveries, ecology, quantum physics
- [All Articles (Chronological)](https://phys.org/sort/date/all): All science articles sorted chronologically across topics
- [Featured Stories & Reports](https://phys.org/editorials): Featured science stories and in-depth reports across disciplines

## Physics & Material Sciences

- [Physics News](https://phys.org/physics-news): Latest physics news: optical clocks, quantum physics, superconductivity
- [General Physics News](https://phys.org/physics-news/physics): General physics news: mesoscale physics, materials, particle physics
- [Nanotechnology News](https://phys.org/nanotech-news): Nanotech news: graphene, 2D materials, commercialization challenges
- [Optovolution: Light-Guided Protein Evolution](https://phys.org/news/2026-03-optovolution-evolves-proteins-states.html): EPFL optovolution: light-based protein evolution for dynamic states
- [Carbon Nitride Photocatalyst Design](https://phys.org/news/2026-03-h8322o8322-method-narrows-carbon-nitride.html): CASUS carbon nitride photocatalyst design for H₂O₂ production

## Biology & Environmental Sciences

- [Biology News](https://phys.org/biology-news): Biology news: viruses, invasive species, genetics research
- [Social & Earth Sciences News](https://phys.org/science-news): Social sciences: education, behavior, archaeology, fossils
- [Invasive Flatworm Spread by Pets](https://phys.org/news/2026-02-dogs-cats-invasive-flatworm-species.html): Pets spread Caenoplana variegata flatworm, France-Australia study
- [Indigenous Concepts of Nonlinear Time](https://phys.org/news/2026-02-indigenous-ideas-nonlinear-ecological-crises.html): Māori nonlinear time concepts for ecological crisis navigation
- [Hurricane Research](https://phys.org/concepts/hurricanes): Hurricane research: tropical cyclones, storm surge, climate impacts

## Education & AI Research

- [AI Tutor for College Reasoning](https://phys.org/news/2026-03-ai-college-students.html): Macro Buddy AI tutor promotes reasoning over answer-giving
- [Human-AI Hybrid Tutoring Study](https://phys.org/news/2025-10-adding-human-guidance-ai-benefits.html): CMU study: human-AI hybrid tutoring improves student outcomes
- [Hands-On Science Education with LEDs](https://phys.org/news/2026-02-logic-science-tangible-classroom.html): TU/e I.C. Tycoon game teaches chip design through hands-on play
- [Remote Work and Birth Rates](https://phys.org/news/2026-03-home-reverse-declining-birth.html): King's College study: remote work linked to higher birth rates
